test_cases.summary:
Verify Image rejection at Level processes without delay
when an image is in IN_REVIEW
test_cases.description:
Feature: Reject action responsiveness

Scenario: Image rejection at Level processes without delay

Given an image is in IN_REVIEW
When the Level user clicks Reject
Then the image should move to the previous level immediately without UI freeze
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should move to the previous level immediately without UI freeze
The behavior should be validated when the Level user clicks Reject.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Image acceptance at Level loads smoothly
when the image reaches IN_REVIEW L
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multi-level approval performance consistency

Scenario: Image acceptance at Level loads smoothly

Given the image reaches IN_REVIEW L
When the Level user accepts the image
Then status transition to Level should occur without delay
test_cases.acceptance:
Status transition to Level should occur without delay
The behavior should be validated when the Level user accepts the image.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Image review at Level performs efficiently
when the user logs in as Approval Level
test_cases.description:
Feature: High-level approval workflow responsiveness

Scenario: Image review at Level performs efficiently

Given the user logs in as Approval Level
When images and session details are loaded
Then all UI elements should respond quickly without lag
test_cases.acceptance:
All UI elements should respond quickly without lag
The behavior should be validated when images and session details are loaded.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Final accept/reject at Level  completes without delay
when the image is in IN_REVIEW L
test_cases.description:
Feature: Final approval performance handling

Scenario: Final accept/reject at Level  completes without delay

Given the image is in IN_REVIEW L
When the Level  user clicks Accept or Reject
Then the final status update should reflect immediately
test_cases.acceptance:
The final status update should reflect immediately
The behavior should be validated when the Level  user clicks Accept or Reject.

test_cases.summary:
Verify UI remains responsive after accept/reject actions
when an approval action is completed at any level
test_cases.description:
Feature: Post-action UI stability

Scenario: UI remains responsive after accept/reject actions

Given an approval action is completed at any level
When the image grid refreshes
Then no UI freeze, delay, or blocking behavior should occur
test_cases.acceptance:
No UI freeze, delay, or blocking behavior should occur
The behavior should be validated when the image grid refreshes.

test_cases.summary:
Verify System shows non-blocking indicator if minor delay occurs
when a temporary processing delay happens
test_cases.description:
Feature: Non-blocking delay handling

Scenario: System shows non-blocking indicator if minor delay occurs

Given a temporary processing delay happens
When approval action is submitted
Then a non-blocking status indicator should be shown without locking UI
test_cases.acceptance:
A non-blocking status indicator should be shown without locking UI
The behavior should be validated when approval action is submitted.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Image flows from Level 1 to Level 5 smoothly
when the same image is accepted sequentially from Level 1 to Level 5
test_cases.description:
Feature: End-to-end approval performance

Scenario: Image flows from Level 1 to Level 5 smoothly

Given the same image is accepted sequentially from Level 1 to Level 5
When each level user logs in and performs action
Then no cumulative delay or performance degradation should occur
test_cases.acceptance:
No cumulative delay or performance degradation should occur
The behavior should be validated when each level user logs in and performs action.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Assignee and Approval users see consistent layout
when the user logs in as Assignee or Approval Level user
test_cases.description:
Feature: Clear and consistent UI across roles

Scenario: Assignee and Approval users see consistent layout

Given the user logs in as Assignee or Approval Level user
When the Data Labeling page is opened
Then the page layout, icons, and controls should be consistent across roles
test_cases.acceptance:
The page layout, icons, and controls should be consistent across roles
The behavior should be validated when the Data Labeling page is opened.

test_cases.summary:
Verify User can easily identify image status
when images are displayed in the grid
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image status clarity

Scenario: User can easily identify image status

Given images are displayed in the grid
When the user views image cards
Then status labels such as PENDING, IN_REVIEW, ACCEPTED, REJECTED should be clearly visible
test_cases.acceptance:
Status labels such as PENDING, IN_REVIEW, ACCEPTED, REJECTED should be clearly visible
The behavior should be validated when the user views image cards.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Approval level is clearly indicated on images
when an image is under review
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval level indicator visibility

Scenario: Approval level is clearly indicated on images

Given an image is under review
When the image card is displayed
Then approval level indicators like L1, L2, L3, L4, L5 should be clearly shown
test_cases.acceptance:
Approval level indicators like L1, L2, L3, L4, L5 should be clearly shown
The behavior should be validated when the image card is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify User navigates between sessions smoothly

Feature: Easy navigation across sessions

Given the user is on the Session list page
When the user navigates between different sessions
Then navigation should be intuitive with clear breadcrumbs and page titles
test_cases.acceptance:
Navigation should be intuitive with clear breadcrumbs and page titles

test_cases.summary:

when users at different approval levels access the same workflow

test_cases.summary:

test_cases.summary:
Verify UI updates instantly after user action
when the user performs Accept or Reject action

test_cases.summary:
Verify User understands why actions are disabled
when the image is not in the user's active approval level

test_cases.acceptance:
Edit and action controls should be disabled with clear indication
The behavior should be validated when the user views the image.
